text:
COMPLETE, with one oversight flag you should act on.

Email Agent sent the Seal Team Slicks email from Sam Outlook at 2:40pm ET as a reply on the Introductory Call thread. To: Phil DiGristina (sealteamslicks@gmail.com). CC: Eric Shymanik (eshy2025@yahoo.com) and phildigristina@sealteamslicks.com. Both men from the call are included.

Attachments verified (2): PLL-NDA-Seal-Team-Slicks-2026-09-02.pdf and PLL Product Development Brief Form.pdf. I downloaded and opened the sent NDA: it is genuinely customized, not a blank template. Named to Seal Team Slicks, Eric Shymanik and Philip DiGristina, dated September 2 2026, correct Farmington Hills address and current 248-938-4181 number, counterparty signature lines left blank for signing. Body contains no false start and no delivery or price commitments.

FLAG - NDA is one-way and does not protect PLL. The document sent states the Client may disclose confidential information to the Manufacturer, and obligates only PLL to keep it secret. There is no mutual clause. PLL formulas, processes, pricing and know-how are NOT covered. Our standard PLL Mutual NDA covers both sides, including formulas, manufacturing methods, and margin information. On a seven product R&D program where we will expose formulation and cost work, that gap is real. They have not signed yet, so it is cleanly fixable.

RECOMMEND: send the mutual version as the copy to sign. Approve and I will prepare it for your review first.

Reporting note: Email Agent executed but never published its callback, so I verified the send independently in Sent Items rather than trust or re-send. Third missed report in seven days - its brief needs correcting.

Minor: NDA signed Title CEO while prior NDAs signed Co-Founder (still undecided), and the email used a plain-text signature without the PLL logo block.
